environment.note: In-process simulator on this host. Install time is engine and localhost download time, not RAUC flash time.
environment.qemu: not measured; QUALIFY_QEMU_IMAGE is unset or not a file

recover_abort.note: NeedsRecovery is the ambiguous install path. recover-abort is the operator call on the simulator, not a board power cycle.

relay.note: Localhost relay. WAN bytes not sent are client bytes minus the single upstream read. This is not a wide-area link.

rollback.note: Wall time includes the configured health deadline. The simulator restores the previous slot in-process.
